chunks: And Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from Zayd ibn al-Jahm al-Hilali, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah عليه السلام about a man who marries a woman while she has a daughter from another man: may he marry his son to her daughter?
He عليه السلام said: "If she was from a husband before he married her, then there is no harm. But if she was from a husband after he married her, then no."

key_terms.ابْنَةٌ: a daughter connected to the woman from another husband
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةَ: the woman being discussed in the marriage ruling
key_terms.زَوْجٍ: husband in relation to the woman’s prior or later marriage
key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Can a man marry his son to the daughter of a woman he married if that daughter is from another husband?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning marriage relations formed through a woman’s daughter from another husband. It distinguishes between a daughter from a prior husband, which poses no impediment for marrying one’s son to her, and a daughter from a later husband, which is not permitted.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4490 - Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from Zayd ibn al-Jahm al-Hilali, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (as) about a man who marries a woman, and she has a daughter from another man. Can he marry his son to her daughter?

Imam (as) said: "If the daughter is from a husband she had before he married her, then there is no harm. But if the daughter is from a husband she had after he married her, then no, it is not permissible."
